decisions.quote:
These results have to be considered only as a qualitative
         and preliminary insight, as the sample size collected for the weeks of interest did not allow any
         meaningful statistical inference to be made. In fact, graphical disparities among scores might be
         mere random variation and they might not reflect real differences.
decisions.reason: The paper combines a robustness re-analysis of the original Wave 1 UK dataset using alternative machine learning models (Part 1) with a new-sample replication testing the U-shaped loneliness pattern in Wave 2 (Part 2). For the Wave 2 replication test, only 15 participants were available across weeks 3 to 9, and the authors explicitly state that the sample size did not allow any meaningful statistical inference and that observed graphical disparities might be mere random variation. Under the codebook, when the authors' own verdict is that a sample-size limitation prevents a meaningful test of the original claim, the replication outcome is 'uninformative'.
